title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Title: Senior Azure Administrator / DevOps Engineer 
 Experience: 4-7 Years
 Location: Mohali (Work from Office)
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Job Overview: We are looking for an experienced Senior Azure Administrator / DevOps Engineer to manage and maintain production cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes environments, deployment pipelines, security, monitoring, and reliability of enterprise SaaS applications hosted on Microsoft Azure. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure infrastructure and networking, and deploying and operating Node.js applications in production environments. 
 Key Responsibilities: Manage and maintain Azure cloud infrastructure across production, staging, UAT, and development environments. Administer and optimize Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), including node pools, autoscaling, upgrades, and cluster management. Manage Azure networking, VNets, Subnets, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Private DNS, and Hub-Spoke architecture. Configure Azure Front Door, WAF, NGINX Ingress, TLS certificates, DNS, and traffic routing. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions. Manage Docker, Kubernetes, Helm Charts, container registries, and deployment strategies. Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Prometheus, and Grafana. Manage Azure MySQL, Redis, Storage Accounts, Key Vault, Event Hubs, and other Azure services. Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates. Handle production troubleshooting, incident management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), backup, and disaster recovery. Implement cloud security practices, RBAC, Managed Identities, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation. Optimize cloud infrastructure costs, capacity, performance, and reliability. 
 Required Skills: 47 years of experience in DevOps, Azure Administration, Cloud Infrastructure, or SRE. Minimum 23 years of hands-on production experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure services and cloud networking. Hands-on experience deploying and managing Node.js applications in production. Strong expertise in Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and containerized deployments. Experience with Azure Front Door, WAF, NGINX Ingress, VNets, NSGs, and Private Endpoints. Experience with CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions. Knowledge of Terraform/Bicep, Linux administration, and shell scripting. Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and production incident management. Working knowledge of Azure Database for MySQL and Redis. 
 Certification: AZ-104 Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (Preferred requirement in the JD: at least one relevant Azure certification). AZ-400, AZ-305, or AZ-500 are additional preferred certifications. 
 Good to Have: Azure Event Hubs, Azure Web PubSub, Azure AI Services, and ADLS Gen2. Multi-region deployments and high-availability architecture. Disaster Recovery, ISO 27001, VAPT, SAST/SCA, and FinOps experience. Experience working with high-scale B2B SaaS platforms. 
 Important: This is an infrastructure ownership role, not just a CI/CD pipeline management position. The candidate should be capable of independently managing Azure infrastructure, production environments, security, reliability, and disaster recovery.

Key Skills: Devops,Kubernetes,Senior,Azure Devops,Cd,Cd,Aks,CI Cd Pipeline
